fields.exists: Hexoloy SA process tubes: OD 25 to 381 mm, single piece to 1.4 m, bonded assemblies to 4.9 m. Seal tubes are about 0.30 m long. Silit SiSiC radiant tubes reach OD 300 mm, length 3.5 m, thinnest published wall about 4 mm, Amasic-3D about 2 mm.
fields.state: PENDING-025. A 250 mm class diameter exists. A 2 m single Hexoloy piece does not. A wall near 0.9 mm is below the 2 mm SiSiC floor and is a PROJECTION for alpha-SiC. MAINLINE-025 owns the manufacture row. These factors are context at the sourced-today geometry, not a closed finding.
fields.source: https://www.ceramicsrefractories.saint-gobain.com/products/shapes/tubes/hexoloy-sic-process-tubes and the ceramic radiant tube page
